title: Worthy Is the Lamb
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: No one was worthy to open the scroll, until the Lamb who was slain. There is no hope as beautiful as our hope in him.
exhortation: John weeps loudly because no one in heaven or on earth is found worthy to open the scroll. Then one of the elders says, "Weep no more; behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered." And John looks and sees a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain.

The Lamb approaches the throne of God Almighty and takes the scroll from his hand, the scroll no one else could take. And heaven erupts. The living creatures and the elders fall down and sing a new song: "Worthy are you to take the scroll and to open its seals, for you were slain, and by your blood you ransomed people for God from every tribe and language and people and nation." Then myriads of myriads of angels join in: "Worthy is the Lamb who was slain."

There is no hope as beautiful as our hope in the Lamb who was slain. He is a strange and unexpected champion, a Savior no one could have foreseen, and yet he was prophesied for generations: a King of humility who conquers completely. What an incredible and glorious salvation we have.
prayer: Lord, set in our hearts a longing to see you come and reign, to conquer and receive glory on this earth full of wickedness, sin and darkness. Let the Light of light come, and let our salvation split the skies in your return.

Along with that, give us a passion to spread your gospel and to speak boldly of the great salvation that comes through your blood sacrifice for us. Come, Lord Jesus. The Spirit and the bride say come. Amen.
